hints: `Files.readString` gives the exact character count; `Files.readAllLines` gives the lines without their line breaks.

`Files.walk(dir)` visits everything below `dir`; `dir.relativize(p)` turns a full path into one relative to `dir`. `Files.walk` gives a `Stream<Path>` (streams come in lesson 6.02); its `toList()` turns it into a `List<Path>` you can loop over. Close the stream (try-with-resources) when done.
